instruction: Cinematic full-length profile photograph of a minimalist indoor studio with a concrete floor and a white wall covered in handprint papers. On the left, the woman in the white crop top (R2) stands facing right with her feet positioned close together. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt (R1) stands facing left. They stand facing each other, touching their raised left palms at chest height with neutral expressions. Soft, diffused overhead lighting illuminates the scene, creating a muted color palette of whites, grays, and soft skin tones with gentle shadows.
